pass_policy: all_of; partial or unobservable is fail; both shoes independently must pass
claim_limits: Visible structure only. No fiber content, manufacturing process, biomechanical force, identity or historical event proof.

source_concept_units: The selected apron-style dress front panel joins its own shoulder straps
observations.owner: seated main subject; sage outer dress; separate apricot inner blouse
observations.required_view: Oblique torso view simultaneously exposing both sage bib-to-strap joins and sage edges in front of the separately bounded apricot blouse.
observations.all_of_criterion: Every source concept unit must be visibly embodied by the declared same owner. Both shoes must satisfy the shoe component; one visible end is insufficient.
false_substitutes: A blouse’s decorative bib, a detached apron print or sleeves belonging to the dress itself cannot replace the declared over-dress and inner blouse boundaries.
